parityBins.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, Current Population Survey June Fertility Supplement, children-ever-born bins: none, one, two, three, four, five and six, seven or more.

completedFertility.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, Historical Table 2, Distribution of Women Age 40 to 50 by Number of Children Ever Born and Marital Status: Selected Years, 1970 to 2024 (h2.xlsx, sha256 ed0576eadad310efaf09980529bb03fc8a6ee67514ac6e1154b7e0b45b6d732e), all marital classes, women 40 to 44, percent by children ever born.

fertilityByAge.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, Table 1. Women's Number of Children Ever Born by Age and Marital Status: June 2018 (t1.xlsx, sha256 491e05e528153c09799ed4ad5a37d3e16e91b38df1f5c415b45823edff359566), all women, all marital statuses.

firstBirthAge.citation: NCHS Data Brief 21 (2009): mean age of mother at first birth 21.4 in 1970 and 25.0 in 2006; NCHS Data Brief 232 (2016): 24.9 in 2000, 25.2 in 2009, 26.3 in 2014; NCFMR Family Profile FP-18-25: 26.8 in 2017; 27.5 in 2023 (Natality, as reported in PMC12278045). Years before 1970 hold the 1970 value.

firstMarriageIntact.citation: Copen, Daniels, Vespa and Mosher (2012), First marriages in the United States: data from the 2006-2010 National Survey of Family Growth, National Health Statistics Reports 49, Table 5: probability that a woman's first marriage remains intact 5, 10, 15 and 20 years after it began (0.80, 0.68, 0.60, 0.52). Durations past 20 years hold the 20-year value.

personality.citation: Age curves: Terracciano, McCrae, Brant and Costa (2005), Hierarchical linear modeling analyses of the NEO-PI-R scales in the Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging, Psychology and Aging 20(3), Table 2 (T scores, mean 50, SD 10, age centered at 64.5 and counted in decades; A4 quadratic term not legible in the manuscript, held at zero). Sex differences: Kajonius and Johnson (2018), Sex differences in 30 facets of the five factor model of personality in the large public (N = 320,128), Personality and Individual Differences 129, Table 1, d = male minus female.

levels.citation: The owner-accepted seeded spread SEED_SPREAD = [-2, -1, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 2] in src/simulation/people-trait-pack.ts: 10%, 20%, 40%, 20%, 10% of people at -2..2. Cut points are the standard normal quantiles at 10%, 30%, 70% and 90%.

gaps: Relatives living outside the household are light husk-tier records in their own households; they are never matched to other residents of the town.
Siblings' and adult children's partners, and cousins, are not generated.
Men's children ever born use the women's table shifted later by a tunable number of years.
Upbringing still estimates sibling count from its own SIPP distribution instead of reading the generated siblings.
Relatives live in the household's county or elsewhere in the state; out-of-state residence is not represented.
When parents' marriage ended, the mother keeps the family home and any minor children and the father lives apart; custody is not decided from each family's circumstances.
A marriage is dated from the first child's birth, and none ends after 20 years.
